fact: On 28 January 2026 the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications issued a call for expressions of interest for studies to set up a Data Analysis and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (LAD-IA) for the ministry, funded from the 2026 FSE budget, with offers due 13 March 2026.
title: Avis d'appel à manifestation d'intérêt n°0000002/AMI/MPT/SG/DAG/SDBM/SMA/2026 du 28 janvier 2026 (LAD-IA)
publisher: Ministère des Postes et Télécommunications (via ARMP)
